notes: Completed story set for EVAL-CT-M3 with full lifecycle coverage.

stories.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic schema defining inputs (user query intent, normalized condition terms, eligibility signals) and outputs (relevance score, match rationale, eligibility flags). Ensure compatibility with existing clinical trials tool models.

stories.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria text. Include normalization (synonyms, case handling), lightweight eligibility parsing (inclusion/exclusion signals), and scoring heuristics.

stories.title: Expose Relevance Scoring via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate relevance scoring into clinical trials search flow and expose structured relevance signals (score, matched condition, eligibility fit) through evaluate_care_facade for downstream rendering.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Matching and Scoring
stories.description: Create unit tests validating condition normalization, eligibility parsing, and scoring outputs across representative scenarios (exact match, partial match, exclusion mismatch, missing data).

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Clinical Trials Search Flow
stories.description: Validate that relevance scoring integrates with ClinicalTrials.gov search results, ensuring each returned trial includes relevance metadata and does not break existing response formatting.
